title: 농ㆍ축산ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 기자재 및 석유류에 대한 부가가치세 영세율 및 면세 적용 등에 관한 특례규정 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 재정경제부 (부가가치세제과), 044-215-4326
rows.text_en: Ministry of Finance and Economy ( Value Added Tax Division ), 044-215-4326

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「농ㆍ축산ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 기자재 및 석유류에 대한 부가가치세 영세율 및 면세 적용 등에 관한 특례규정」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2007. 3. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Special Provisions on the Application of Zero-Rate VAT and Exemption, etc., for Equipment and Materials for Agriculture, Livestock, Forestry, and Fisheries and Petroleum Products” and matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Mar. 29, 2007>
Article 2 Deleted <Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(월별판매액합계표 등의 서식) ①「농ㆍ축산ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 기자재 및 석유류에 대한 부가가치세 영세율 및 면세 적용 등에 관한 특례규정」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제1호 본문에 따른 월별판매액합계표는 별지 제1호서식과 같다. <개정 2025. 3. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Forms for Monthly Sales Summary Tables, etc.) ① The monthly sales summary table pursuant to the main text of Article 4 , Subparagraph 1 of the “Special Provisions on the Application of Zero-Rate and Exemption from Value Added Tax on Equipment and Materials for Agriculture, Livestock, Forestry, and Fisheries and Petroleum Products” (hereinafter referred to as the “Enforcement Decree”) shall be in the form of Attached Form No. 1. <Amended Mar. 21, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제4조제1호 단서의 규정에 의한 임업용기자재구매확인서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The confirmation of purchase of forestry equipment pursuant to the proviso of Article 4, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in Attached Form No. 2.

rows.source_ko: ③영 제4조제2호의 규정에 의한 납품확인서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The delivery confirmation certificate pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 3 .

rows.source_ko: ④영 제5조의 규정에 의한 판매기록표는 별지 제4호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The sales record sheet pursuant to the provisions of Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 4 .
Article 4 Deleted <Mar. 29, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(환급대행자) 영 제9조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “재정경제부령이 정하는 자”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자를 말한다. <개정 2007. 3. 29., 2008. 4. 24., 2009. 3. 30., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Refund Agents) In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 29, 2007; Apr. 24, 2008; Mar. 30, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 환급을 받고자 하는 자가 개인(「부가가치세법」 또는 「소득세법」의 규정에 따라 사업자등록을 한 자를 제외한다)인 경우에는 다음 각목의 구분에 따른 「농업협동조합법」에 의한 조합, 「수산업협동조합법」에 의한 수산업협동조합 또는 「엽연초생산협동조합법」에 의한 엽연초생산협동조합(이하 이 조에서 “조합등”이라 한다)
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where the person seeking a refund is an individual ( excluding those who have registered as a business operator in accordance with the provisions of the Value Added Tax Act or the Income Tax Act ) , a cooperative under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act , a fisheries cooperative under the Fisheries Cooperatives Act , or a leaf tobacco production cooperative under the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act, as classified in each of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as “cooperatives, etc.” in this Article)

rows.source_ko: 가. 환급을 받고자 하는 자가 조합등에 조합원으로 등록되어 있는 경우에는 그 조합원으로 등록된 조합등
rows.text_en: a. In cases where the person seeking a refund is registered as a member of an association, etc., the association, etc. to which the person is registered as a member

rows.source_ko: 나. 가목외의 경우에는 환급받고자 하는 자의 주소지 또는 거주지 관할 조합등
rows.text_en: B. In cases other than those specified in Item A, the association, etc. having jurisdiction over the address or residence of the person seeking the refund

rows.source_ko: 2. 환급을 받고자 하는 자가 제1호외의 자인 경우에는 그 자의 사업장 소재지 관할 조합등
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where the person seeking a refund is a person other than those specified in Subparagraph 1, the association, etc. having jurisdiction over the location of that person's business establishment

rows.source_ko: 제6조(환급대행신청서 등의 서식) ①영 제9조제2항에 따른 농ㆍ임ㆍ어업용기자재부가가치세환급대행신청서는 별지 제5호서식과 같다. <개정 2015. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Forms for Applications for Refund Agency, etc.) ① The application form for the refund agency of value-added tax on agricultural, forestry, and fishery equipment pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as in Annex 5. <Amended Mar. 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제9조제3항 및 제4항에 따른 농ㆍ임ㆍ어업용기자재부가가치세환급신청서는 별지 제6호서식과 같다. <개정 2015. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: ② The application form for the refund of value-added tax on agricultural, forestry, and fishery equipment and materials pursuant to Article 9, Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as attached Form No. 6. <Amended Mar. 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③영 제9조제3항제2호의 규정에 의한 매입세금계산서합계표는 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The summary table of purchase tax invoices pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 7 .

rows.source_ko: ④영 제9조제3항제3호에 따른 농ㆍ임ㆍ어업용기자재부가가치세환급신청명세서는 별지 제8호서식과 같다. <개정 2015. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Statement of Application for Value Added Tax Refund for Equipment and Materials for Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤영 제9조제7항에 따른 농ㆍ임ㆍ어업용기자재부가가치세환급관리대장은 별지 제9호서식과 같다. <개정 2015. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Value Added Tax Refund Management Register for agricultural, forestry, and fishery equipment and materials pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 13, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(농ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 면세유류의 범위) ① 영 제15조제1항제1호다목에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 시설”이란 별표 1의 면세유류 구입카드등(「조세특례제한법」 제106조의2제4항에 따른 면세유류 구입카드등을 말한다. 이하 같다) 교부대상 시설을 말한다. <개정 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Scope of Tax-Exempt Fuel for Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries) ① In Article 15, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (c) of the Enforcement Decree, the term “facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to facilities subject to the issuance of tax-exempt fuel purchase cards, etc., as set forth in Annex 1 ( referring to tax-exempt fuel purchase cards, etc., pursuant to Article 106-2, Paragraph 4 of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act; hereinafter the same applies). <Amended Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제15조제1항제2호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 농업기계, 임업기계, 어업기계”란 별표 2, 별표 3 및 별표 4의 면세유류 구입카드등 교부대상 농업기계, 임업기계 및 어업기계를 말한다. <개정 2013. 2. 23., 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 15 , Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, “agricultural machinery, forestry machinery, and fisheries machinery prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to agricultural machinery, forestry machinery, and fisheries machinery subject to the issuance of tax-exempt fuel purchase cards, etc., as specified in Annexes 2 , 3 , and 4. <Amended Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 18, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2002]
Article 7-2 Deleted <April 24, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(석유판매업자의 환급신청서 등) ① 영 제15조의2제3항에 따른 석유판매업자의 면세유류 감면세액 환급신청서는 별지 제10호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Refund, etc. by Petroleum Retailer) ① The application for refund of tax reduction on tax-exempt fuel by a petroleum retailer pursuant to Article 15-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제15조의2제5항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 자료”란 교통ㆍ에너지ㆍ환경세의 감면세액 환급내역을 말하며, 그 통보서식은 별지 제11호서식과 같다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 15-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree, “data prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the details of refunds for tax exemptions and reductions under the Transportation, Energy, and Environment Tax, and the notification form shall be as in Annex 11. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>
[Wholly Amended Apr. 24, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(보유현황 신고 강화 대상 농업기계 등) 영 제15조의3제2항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 농업기계, 임업기계 및 어업기계”란 별표 2 제2호, 제3호, 제7호, 제17호, 제43호(2톤 이상 4톤 미만인 것만 해당한다), 제45호 및 별표 4 제1호부터 제3호까지의 기계를 말한다. <개정 2014. 3. 14., 2016. 3. 9., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Agricultural Machinery, etc. Subject to Strengthened Reporting Requirements for Ownership Status) In Paragraph 2 of Article 15-3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “agricultural machinery, forestry machinery, and fisheries machinery prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the machinery specified in Subparagraphs 2 , 3, 7, 17, 43 (only applicable to those weighing 2 tons or more but less than 4 tons), and 45 of Annex 2, and Items 1 through 3 of Annex 4. <Amended Mar. 14, 2014; Mar. 9, 2016; Jan. 2, 2026; Mar. 20, 2026>
1. Deleted <March 14, 2014>
2. Deleted <March 14, 2014>
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 23, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의3(농기계 등 보유현황 등 신고서의 서식) ① 영 제15조의3제3항에 따른 신고서는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-3 (Form of Report on Status of Ownership of Agricultural Machinery, etc.) ① The report form pursuant to Article 15-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제14조제1호에 따른 농민(이하 이 조에서 “농민”이라 한다)이 농업기계의 보유현황과 영농사실을 「농업협동조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의2서식의 농업기계 보유현황 및 영농사실 신고서
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where a farmer pursuant to Article 14 , Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “farmer” in this Article) reports the status of agricultural machinery ownership and farming activities to a cooperative pursuant to the Agricultural Cooperatives Act : Report on Agricultural Machinery Ownership Status and Farming Activities in Form No. 11-2

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제14조제2호에 따른 임업인(이하 이 조에서 “임업인”이라 한다)이 임업기계의 보유현황과 영림사실을 「산림조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의3서식의 임업기계 보유현황 및 영림사실 신고서
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where a forester pursuant to Article 14 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “forestry worker” in this Article) reports the status of forestry machinery ownership and forest management activities to an association pursuant to the Forestry Associations Act : Report on Forestry Machinery Ownership Status and Forest Management Activities in Form No. 11-3

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제14조제3호에 따른 어민(이하 이 조에서 “어민”이라 한다)이 어업기계, 선박 및 시설 등의 보유현황과 어업경영사실을 「농업협동조합법」에 따른 조합 또는 「수산업협동조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의4서식의 어업기계, 선박 및 시설 등의 보유현황 및 어업경영사실 신고서
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where a fisherman pursuant to Article 14, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “fisherman” in this Article) reports the status of ownership of fishing machinery, vessels, facilities, etc., and facts of fishing operations to a cooperative under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act or a cooperative under the Fisheries Cooperatives Act : Report on the Status of Ownership of Fishing Machinery, Vessels, Facilities, etc., and Facts of Fishing Operations in Form No. 11-4 of the Appendix

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제15조의3제3항에 따른 변동내용신고서는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The report on changes pursuant to Article 15-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농민이 농업기계의 보유현황과 영농사실의 변동내용을 「농업협동조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의5서식의 농업기계 보유현황 및 영농사실 변동내용신고서
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where a farmer reports the status of agricultural machinery ownership and changes in farming activities to a cooperative pursuant to the Agricultural Cooperatives Act : Report on Status of Agricultural Machinery Ownership and Changes in Farming Activities ( Form No. 11-5)

rows.source_ko: 2. 임업인이 임업기계의 보유현황과 영림사실의 변동내용을 「산림조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의6서식의 임업기계 보유현황 및 영림사실 변동내용신고서
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where a forester reports the status of forestry machinery ownership and changes in forestry activities to an association pursuant to the Forestry Association Act : Report on Status of Forestry Machinery Ownership and Changes in Forestry Activities ( Form No. 11-6)

rows.source_ko: 3. 어민이 어업기계, 선박 및 시설 등의 보유현황과 어업경영사실의 변동내용을 「농업협동조합법」에 따른 조합 또는 「수산업협동조합법」에 따른 조합에 신고하는 경우: 별지 제11호의7서식의 어업기계, 선박 및 시설 등의 보유현황 및 어업경영사실 변동내용신고서
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where a fisherman reports the current status of ownership of fishing machinery, vessels, facilities, etc., and changes in fishing business operations to a cooperative under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act or a cooperative under the Fisheries Cooperatives Act : Report on the Current Status of Ownership of Fishing Machinery, Vessels, Facilities, etc., and Changes in Fishing Business Operations ( Form No. 11-7)
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 20, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(면세유류구입카드 등) ① 영 제16조제1호에 따른 면세유류구입카드는 직불카드의 교부를 원칙으로 하되, 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 면세석유류의 원활한 공급 및 사용자의 편의를 위하여 필요하다고 인정하여 신용카드업자에게 통보하는 경우에는 신용카드를 교부한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Tax-Exempt Fuel Purchase Cards, etc.) ① In principle, tax-exempt fuel purchase cards pursuant to Article 16 , Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be issued as debit cards; however, if the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries deems it necessary for the smooth supply of tax-exempt petroleum products and the convenience of users, and notifies a credit card issuer, credit cards shall be issued. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 면세유류구입카드 교부에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 정하는 바에 따른다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Matters necessary for the issuance of tax-exempt fuel purchase cards pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Apr. 24, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(사용실적신고서의 서식) 영 제17조제3항에 따른 사용실적신고서는 별지 제12호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Form of Report on Usage Performance) The report on usage performance pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 12 .
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 24, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(면세유류판매업자 지정요건) ① 영 제20조의2제1항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 시설기준, 그 밖의 요건”이란 다음 각 호의 요건을 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Requirements for Designation of Tax-Exempt Fuel Retailers) ① In Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “facility standards and other requirements prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농ㆍ어민등에게 공급한 석유제품별 물량이 면세유류구입카드 매출전표 또는 영수증에 구분 표시되어 농ㆍ어민등에게 교부되도록 영 제16조제1호에 따른 면세유류구입카드를 인식할 수 있는 단말기가 설치되어 있을 것
rows.text_en: 1. A terminal capable of recognizing the tax-exempt fuel purchase card pursuant to Article 16, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be installed so that the quantity of each petroleum product supplied to farmers, fishermen, etc. is separately indicated on the sales slip or receipt of the tax-exempt fuel purchase card and issued to the farmers, fishermen, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제15조의2제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자일 것
rows.text_en: 2. A person falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 15-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree
